default.$description: Default contained surface such as a card, table, menu, or dialog.

hover.$description: Legacy surface hover, mapped to the neutral interaction overlay.

active.$description: Legacy surface active state, mapped to the neutral pressed overlay.

default.$description: Page-level canvas matching the default surface.

disabled.$description: Background for unavailable controls and regions.

subtle.$description: Subtle surface used to establish low-emphasis hierarchy.

strong.$description: Strong boundary required to identify a control.
Strong contextual overlay; not a modal scrim.

default.$description: Weak AI, upgrade, upsell, pricing, or feature surface.

border.$description: Boundary for an explicit feature treatment.

default.$description: Neutral action link; components must underline it.

hover.$description: Hovered neutral action link; components must underline it.

foreground.$description: Readable foreground on a solid purple decorative avatar.
Readable foreground on a solid teal decorative avatar.

suppressed.$description: A parent already provides containment. Deliberately flat.

resting.$description: Interactive or contained surface at rest, flush with the page.

attached.$description: Structural chrome lifted off the page plane without overlaying content.

anchored.$description: Dismissible transient surface anchored to a trigger.

overData.$description: Surface that must remain legible above dense data, charts, tables, or imagery.
